# Fase 1 — Importação e Estruturação

```{r import-data}
# Homologous CRE pairs from ENCODE (hg38–mm10)
homologous_cres <- read_tsv(
  here("Genomic", "hg38-mm10-Homologous.tsv"),
  col_names = c("human_enhancer", "mouse_enhancer"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Human CREs (GRCh38)
cres_human <- read_tsv(
  here("Genomic", "GRCh38-cCREs.bed"),
  col_names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "id_dhs", "id_ccre", "type"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(., "_human"))

# Mouse CREs (mm10)
cres_mouse <- read_tsv(
  here("Genomic", "mm10-cCREs.bed"),
  col_names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "id_dhs", "id_ccre", "type"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(., "_mouse"))

library(biomaRt)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

# Recarregar o arquivo com todos os 13 nomes corretos
genes_cres_human <- read_tsv(
  here("Genomic", "GRCh38-Closest-Genes-PC.tsv"),
  col_names = c(
    "chrom_cre", "start_cre", "end_cre", "id_dhs", "id_ccre", "type_cre",
    "chrom_gene", "start_gene", "end_gene", "transcript_id",
    "score_gene", "strand_gene", "gene_id"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# GET GENE NAMES
# Conectar ao Ensembl (GRCh38)
mart <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# IDs únicos sem sufixo de versão (ex: ENSG00000186092.7 → ENSG00000186092)
ensembl_ids <- genes_cres_human$gene_id |>
  unique() |>
  sub("\\..*", "", x = _)

# Baixar hgnc_symbol e gene_biotype
gene_names <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  filters    = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values     = ensembl_ids,
  mart       = mart
)

# Cruzar com a tabela
genes_cres_human <- genes_cres_human %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)) %>%
  left_join(gene_names, by = c("gene_id_clean" = "ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-gene_id_clean)

genes_cres_human |> select(id_ccre, gene_id, hgnc_symbol, gene_biotype) |> head(10)



genes_cres_human %>% 
  filter(hgnc_symbol == "CD2")




```

```{r classify-match-type}
# Count how many mouse CREs each human CRE maps to (and vice versa)
human_counts <- homologous_cres %>%
  dplyr::count(human_enhancer, name = "n_mouse_per_human")

mouse_counts <- homologous_cres %>%
  dplyr::count(mouse_enhancer, name = "n_human_per_mouse")

# Full join: preserves orphan CREs on both sides
cres_annotated <- homologous_cres %>%
  left_join(human_counts, by = "human_enhancer") %>%
  left_join(mouse_counts,  by = "mouse_enhancer") %>%
  full_join(cres_human, by = join_by(human_enhancer == id_ccre_human)) %>%
  full_join(cres_mouse, by = join_by(mouse_enhancer == id_ccre_mouse)) %>%
  mutate(
    is_homologous = !is.na(human_enhancer) & !is.na(mouse_enhancer),
    match_type = case_when(
      is.na(human_enhancer)                                          ~ "mouse_only",
      is.na(mouse_enhancer)                                          ~ "human_only",
      n_mouse_per_human == 1 & n_human_per_mouse == 1               ~ "1:1",
      n_mouse_per_human >  1 & n_human_per_mouse == 1               ~ "N:1",
      n_mouse_per_human == 1 & n_human_per_mouse >  1               ~ "1:N",
      TRUE                                                           ~ "N:M"
    )
  )

# Separate tables
cres_homologous <- cres_annotated %>% filter(is_homologous)
cres_human_only <- cres_annotated %>% filter(match_type == "human_only")
cres_mouse_only <- cres_annotated %>% filter(match_type == "mouse_only")

#Summarise
cres_annotated %>%
  dplyr::count(match_type) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))


cres_annotated %>% 
  filter(match_type == "N:M")


#Get how many human only-to-all human ratio

#I


```

- Maioria dos CREs é espécie-específica. Juntos, os CREs exclusivos humanos (42,6%) e murinos (27,4%) totalizam 70% de todos os elementos, o que indica que a maior parte da arquitetura regulatória cis não é compartilhada entre as duas espécies — consistente com a ideia de que a divergência regulatória, e não proteica, explica diferenças de expressão.

- Conservação homóloga é minoritária (\~30%). Apenas \~539k CREs têm correspondência cross-species. Desses, a maioria são pares 1:1 (15,5%), o que sugere uma correspondência funcional direta. Os padrões 1:N e N:1 (\~11%) indicam casos onde uma região regulatória de uma espécie se "expande" ou "contrai" na outra — potencialmente por duplicação ou fusão de elementos.

- Assimetria humano vs. camundongo. Há \~55% mais CREs exclusivos humanos do que murinos (761k vs. 489k). Isso pode refletir: (a) maior complexidade regulatória humana, (b) diferenças no tamanho dos datasets do ENCODE entre as duas espécies, ou (c) diferenças reais de cobertura de tecidos. Vale verificar o número total de CREs em cada espécie antes de interpretar essa assimetria como biológica.

  # Fase 2 — Anotação de Genes Associados

```{r txdb-objects}
txdb_human <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene
txdb_mouse <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
```

## Human

```{r annotate-human-genes}
# Build GRanges only for CREs with valid human coordinates
cres_human_valid <- cres_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom_human), !is.na(start_human), !is.na(end_human))

cres_human_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = cres_human_valid$chrom_human,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = cres_human_valid$start_human,
                     end   = cres_human_valid$end_human)
)
seqlevels(cres_human_gr) <- seqlevels(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
seqinfo(cres_human_gr)   <- seqinfo(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)

# Annotate nearest gene
anno_human <- annotatePeak(
  cres_human_gr,
  tssRegion = c(-3000, 3000),
  TxDb      = txdb_human,
  annoDb    = "org.Hs.eg.db"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(SYMBOL, GENEID, annotation, distanceToTSS)

# Attach back to valid CREs
cres_human_valid <- cres_human_valid %>%
  mutate(
    gene_name_human  = anno_human$SYMBOL,
    gene_id_human    = anno_human$GENEID,
    annotation_human = anno_human$annotation,
    dist_tss_human   = anno_human$distanceToTSS
  )

# Merge back into cres_annotated
cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  left_join(
    cres_human_valid %>%
      select(human_enhancer, chrom_human, start_human,
             gene_name_human, gene_id_human, annotation_human, dist_tss_human),
    by = c("human_enhancer", "chrom_human", "start_human")
  )
```

## Camundongo

```{r annotate-mouse-genes}
cres_mouse_valid <- cres_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(chrom_mouse), !is.na(start_mouse), !is.na(end_mouse))

cres_mouse_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = cres_mouse_valid$chrom_mouse,
  ranges   = IRanges(start = cres_mouse_valid$start_mouse,
                     end   = cres_mouse_valid$end_mouse)
)
seqlevels(cres_mouse_gr) <- seqlevels(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
seqinfo(cres_mouse_gr)   <- seqinfo(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)

anno_mouse <- annotatePeak(
  cres_mouse_gr,
  tssRegion = c(-3000, 3000),
  TxDb      = txdb_mouse,
  annoDb    = "org.Mm.eg.db"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(SYMBOL, GENEID, annotation, distanceToTSS)

cres_mouse_valid <- cres_mouse_valid %>%
  mutate(
    gene_name_mouse  = anno_mouse$SYMBOL,
    gene_id_mouse    = anno_mouse$GENEID,
    annotation_mouse = anno_mouse$annotation,
    dist_tss_mouse   = anno_mouse$distanceToTSS
  )

cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  left_join(
    cres_mouse_valid %>%
      select(mouse_enhancer, chrom_mouse, start_mouse,
             gene_name_mouse, gene_id_mouse, annotation_mouse, dist_tss_mouse),
    by = c("mouse_enhancer", "chrom_mouse", "start_mouse")
  )
```

# Fase 3 — Extração de Sequências

## Sequências dos CREs

```{r sequences-cres}
# Human CRE sequences
seq_cre_human <- getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, cres_human_gr)

# Mouse CRE sequences
seq_cre_mouse <- getSeq(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, cres_mouse_gr)

# Attach to valid subsets
cres_human_valid <- cres_human_valid %>%
  mutate(sequence_cre_human = as.character(seq_cre_human))

cres_mouse_valid <- cres_mouse_valid %>%
  mutate(sequence_cre_mouse = as.character(seq_cre_mouse))

# Merge back
cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  left_join(
    cres_human_valid %>% select(human_enhancer, chrom_human, start_human, sequence_cre_human),
    by = c("human_enhancer", "chrom_human", "start_human")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cres_mouse_valid %>% select(mouse_enhancer, chrom_mouse, start_mouse, sequence_cre_mouse),
    by = c("mouse_enhancer", "chrom_mouse", "start_mouse")
  )
```

## Sequências dos Promotores Associados (2500bp upstream, 300bp downstream)

```{r sequences-promoters}
# Human promoters
genes_human_gr     <- genes(txdb_human)
promoters_human_gr <- promoters(genes_human_gr, upstream = 2500, downstream = 300)
seq_promoter_human <- getSeq(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, promoters_human_gr)

promoter_lookup_human <- setNames(
  as.character(seq_promoter_human),
  names(promoters_human_gr)  # Entrez gene IDs
)

# Mouse promoters
genes_mouse_gr     <- genes(txdb_mouse)
promoters_mouse_gr <- promoters(genes_mouse_gr, upstream = 2500, downstream = 300)
seq_promoter_mouse <- getSeq(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10, promoters_mouse_gr)

promoter_lookup_mouse <- setNames(
  as.character(seq_promoter_mouse),
  names(promoters_mouse_gr)
)

# Attach to annotated table
cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  mutate(
    sequence_promoter_human = promoter_lookup_human[gene_id_human],
    sequence_promoter_mouse = promoter_lookup_mouse[gene_id_mouse]
  )
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Fase 4 — Alinhamento e Identidade de Sequência

Alinhamento local (Smith-Waterman) com gap penalty: abertura = -2, extensão = -1.

```{r alignment-function}
align_pair <- function(seq1, seq2,
                       gap_open = -2, gap_ext = -1) {
  if (is.na(seq1) || is.na(seq2) ||
      nchar(seq1) == 0 || nchar(seq2) == 0) {
    return(list(identity = NA_real_, score = NA_real_, length = NA_integer_))
  }
  aln <- pairwiseAlignment(
    DNAString(seq1), DNAString(seq2),
    type         = "local",
    gapOpening   = gap_open,
    gapExtension = gap_ext
  )
  list(
    identity = pid(aln, type = "PID1"),  # matches / aligned length
    score    = score(aln),
    length   = nchar(alignedSubject(aln))
  )
}
```

```{r align-cres, eval=TRUE}
# Align only homologous CRE pairs
# For large datasets, consider parallelizing with furrr::future_pmap()
cres_to_align <- cres_annotated %>%
  filter(is_homologous, !is.na(sequence_cre_human), !is.na(sequence_cre_mouse)) %>%
  select(human_enhancer, mouse_enhancer, sequence_cre_human, sequence_cre_mouse)

cre_alignments <- cres_to_align %>%
  pmap(function(human_enhancer, mouse_enhancer,
                sequence_cre_human, sequence_cre_mouse) {
    aln <- align_pair(sequence_cre_human, sequence_cre_mouse)
    tibble(
      human_enhancer   = human_enhancer,
      mouse_enhancer   = mouse_enhancer,
      cre_identity_pct = aln$identity,
      cre_align_score  = aln$score,
      cre_align_length = aln$length
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r align-promoters, eval=TRUE}
# Align associated promoter regions
promoters_to_align <- cres_annotated %>%
  filter(
    is_homologous,
    !is.na(sequence_promoter_human),
    !is.na(sequence_promoter_mouse)
  ) %>%
  select(human_enhancer, mouse_enhancer,
         sequence_promoter_human, sequence_promoter_mouse)

promoter_alignments <- promoters_to_align %>%
  pmap(function(human_enhancer, mouse_enhancer,
                sequence_promoter_human, sequence_promoter_mouse) {
    aln <- align_pair(sequence_promoter_human, sequence_promoter_mouse)
    tibble(
      human_enhancer        = human_enhancer,
      mouse_enhancer        = mouse_enhancer,
      promoter_identity_pct = aln$identity,
      promoter_align_score  = aln$score
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Merge alignments back
cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  left_join(cre_alignments,      by = c("human_enhancer", "mouse_enhancer")) %>%
  left_join(promoter_alignments, by = c("human_enhancer", "mouse_enhancer"))
```

# Fase 5 — Conservação Filogenética (PhastCons)

```{r phastcons}
ah <- AnnotationHub()

# Try 7-way vertebrates first; fall back to 60-way mammals
phast_query <- query(ah, c("phastCons", "hg38", "7way"))

if (length(phast_query) > 0) {
  phast_bw   <- phast_query[[1]]
  phast_label <- "7way_vertebrates"
  message("Using phastCons 7-way vertebrates")
} else {
  phast_query60 <- query(ah, c("phastCons", "hg38", "60way"))
  phast_bw      <- phast_query60[[1]]
  phast_label   <- "60way_mammals"
  message("7-way not found — using phastCons 60-way mammals as fallback")
}

# Import scores only over our CRE regions (avoids loading the entire genome)
phast_scores <- import(phast_bw, which = cres_human_gr, as = "RleList")

# Mean PhastCons per CRE
phastcons_avg <- binnedAverage(cres_human_gr, phast_scores, "phastcons_mean")

cres_human_valid <- cres_human_valid %>%
  mutate(phastcons_human = phastcons_avg$phastcons_mean)

cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  left_join(
    cres_human_valid %>%
      select(human_enhancer, chrom_human, start_human, phastcons_human),
    by = c("human_enhancer", "chrom_human", "start_human")
  )
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Fase 6 — Elementos Transponíveis (RepeatMasker)

## Humano

```{r repeatmasker-human}
rmsk_query_hg38 <- query(ah, c("RepeatMasker", "Homo sapiens", "hg38"))
print(rmsk_query_hg38)

# Use the first result; inspect rmsk_query_hg38 to pick a specific version if needed
rmsk_hg38 <- rmsk_query_hg38[[1]]

# Overlap CREs with RepeatMasker regions
hits_human <- findOverlaps(cres_human_gr, rmsk_hg38, ignore.strand = TRUE)

te_human_raw <- tibble(
  cre_idx   = queryHits(hits_human),
  te_name   = rmsk_hg38$repName[subjectHits(hits_human)],
  te_class  = rmsk_hg38$repClass[subjectHits(hits_human)],
  te_family = rmsk_hg38$repFamily[subjectHits(hits_human)]
)

# Collapse: one row per CRE, semicolon-separated classes
te_human_summary <- te_human_raw %>%
  group_by(cre_idx) %>%
  summarise(
    te_overlap_human  = TRUE,
    te_class_human    = paste(sort(unique(te_class)),  collapse = ";"),
    te_family_human   = paste(sort(unique(te_family)), collapse = ";"),
    te_n_elements_human = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Fill in CREs with no overlap
te_human_full <- tibble(cre_idx = seq_along(cres_human_gr)) %>%
  left_join(te_human_summary, by = "cre_idx") %>%
  mutate(te_overlap_human = replace_na(te_overlap_human, FALSE))

cres_human_valid <- cres_human_valid %>%
  mutate(
    te_overlap_human    = te_human_full$te_overlap_human,
    te_class_human      = te_human_full$te_class_human,
    te_family_human     = te_human_full$te_family_human,
    te_n_elements_human = te_human_full$te_n_elements_human
  )

cres_annotated <- cres_annotated %>%
  left_join(
    cres_human_valid %>%
      select(human_enhancer, chrom_human, start_human,
             te_overlap_human, te_class_human, te_family_human, te_n_elements_human),
    by = c("human_enhancer", "chrom_human", "start_human")
  )
```

# Fase 7 — Estatística Descritiva e Exportação

```{r descriptive-stats}
# Conservation overview
cat("=== CRE match type distribution ===\n")
cres_annotated %>%
  count(match_type) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print()

# Sequence identity for homologous CREs
cat("\n=== CRE identity by match type ===\n")
cres_annotated %>%
  filter(is_homologous) %>%
  group_by(match_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n                = n(),
    mean_identity    = round(mean(cre_identity_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_identity  = round(median(cre_identity_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    pct_above_80     = round(mean(cre_identity_pct > 80, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()

# CRE type conservation
cat("\n=== CRE type by homology status ===\n")
cres_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(type_human)) %>%
  count(type_human, is_homologous) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = is_homologous, values_from = n,
              names_prefix = "homologous_") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_conserved = round(100 * homologous_TRUE /
                            (homologous_TRUE + replace_na(homologous_FALSE, 0)), 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(homologous_TRUE)) %>%
  print()

# TE overlap summary
cat("\n=== TE overlap in human CREs ===\n")
cres_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(te_overlap_human)) %>%
  count(is_homologous, te_overlap_human) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = te_overlap_human, values_from = n,
              names_prefix = "te_") %>%
  mutate(pct_with_te = round(100 * te_TRUE / (te_TRUE + replace_na(te_FALSE, 0)), 1)) %>%
  print()

# PhastCons by homology
cat("\n=== PhastCons score by homology status ===\n")
cres_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(phastcons_human)) %>%
  group_by(is_homologous) %>%
  summarise(
    n               = n(),
    mean_phastcons  = round(mean(phastcons_human, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median_phastcons = round(median(phastcons_human, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()
```

```{r export}
# Final split tables
cres_homologous <- cres_annotated %>% filter(is_homologous)
cres_human_only <- cres_annotated %>% filter(match_type == "human_only")
cres_mouse_only <- cres_annotated %>% filter(match_type == "mouse_only")

# Save
saveRDS(cres_annotated,  here("tables", "cres_annotated_full.rds"))
saveRDS(cres_homologous, here("tables", "cres_homologous_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(cres_human_only, here("tables", "cres_human_only_annotated.rds"))
saveRDS(cres_mouse_only, here("tables", "cres_mouse_only_annotated.rds"))

message("All outputs saved to tables/")
```
